pipeline.chord_mix: Demucs htdemucs_6s, sum of bass+guitar+piano+other (vocals/drums removed)
pipeline.teacher: BTC 170-class, frame probabilities via output_projection softmax
pipeline.bass: separated bass stem, RMS-gated chroma argmax

diagnosis: The 30 s unlabeled corpus yields only ~283 usable windows (~4% of the 6,405-window training set). The dominant failure remains cross-song generalization on RWC (train macro 0.83 vs held-out 0.05). Loss/metric tweaks, bass masking, calibration, augmentation, standardization and per-track normalization do not close the gap.
verdict: Gate closure requires an order-of-magnitude increase in independent songs (Slakh2100, SheetSage-Chord, larger unlabeled corpora for BTC relabeling) and/or a representation/architecture change. The reusable Demucs+BTC pipeline is in place for that expansion. Production remains untouched.
